Filters

How to read this / Method
  • Links are interactions, not follows. X follow data is not available through our access. A → B means B quoted A's post, @-mentioned A after A had posted, or appears in a sampled reposted-by list of A's post.
  • Reposter lists are sampled (first ≈25 accounts per post for 64 high-repost posts); likes are not included (no liking-users data was available). Repost times are not exposed, so a repost link appears when both accounts are on the map.
  • Sentiment is model-assessed from post text (labels + an intensity score from −1 to +1; Mixed posts are scored near 0). Account colour = mean score of its posts so far.
  • Follower counts are current (at collection time, 8 Oct 2026), not at posting time.
  • Only accounts that posted about the game in the window are nodes. Net sentiment counters exclude official Ubisoft/Rayman accounts.
